Plugin.Name: U-Manager Files
Plugin.Overview:
A native Unraid file browser. Single Go binary that exposes /mnt/user (or any path you pick) through a REST API and a bundled web UI.
- Browse, copy, move, rename, archive, search and bulk-edit files from any device on your LAN. - Image and video thumbnails out of the box. Optional hardware transcoding (Intel iGPU, VA-API). - Realtime updates over WebSocket so external changes (downloads, SMB writes) reflect instantly. - Logs in with your Unraid account (single sign-on). Optional static API key for scripts. - No Docker required. Runs as a native plugin service.
